hypotheses.rationale: Training loss drops to near zero while validation loss exhibits large fluctuations and spikes after epoch 6, a classic sign of overfitting when too many epochs are run on a small dataset.
A LoRA rank of 16 may limit the model's ability to represent the 77 distinct intent labels, resulting in low training loss but poor generalization to held‑out queries.
Validation loss spikes and inconsistent predictions on semantically similar queries (e.g., pin_blocked vs unable_to_verify_pin) suggest that similar inputs have conflicting labels in the data.
Examples are unusually short (45–103 tokens) and may not reflect the phrasing of real banking queries, causing the model to perform poorly on held‑out items that resemble actual usage.
